rows.verified: Many agricultural machines have dangerous moving parts capable of causing serious or fatal injuries.
Baler hazards include pick-ups, twine mechanisms and moving rear doors.
Combine-harvester hazards include augers in the grain tank and the header unit.
HSE Safe Stop requires the handbrake engaged, controls neutral, engine or power off and the key removed or power locked off.
Machine-specific risk assessment must consider entanglement, trapping and impact points before operation or maintenance.
Agricultural machinery should be designed with guards and other safety devices built into the machine.
Manufacturers and suppliers must provide machinery that is safe for work use, including used equipment.
Relevant essential health and safety requirements for machinery are mandatory and must be considered during design and conformity assessment.
Agricultural-machinery risk depends on machine type, guards, task, operator competence, maintenance, terrain, weather and isolation practice.
HSE agricultural-machinery evidence is machine-, task-, operator-, farm-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Compressed air can cause bodily entry, skin penetration, explosions and eye damage from particles.
Overpressurisation hazards include blockages, control failure, overspeeding, nearby fire, overheating and deposit accumulation.
Compressed-air safety controls cover compressor plant, receivers, dryers, coolers, distribution systems and pneumatic machinery.
Inspection, maintenance and training are core parts of compressed-air risk control.
The Work in Compressed Air Regulations require safe systems, competent persons, suitable plant and health surveillance.
Compressed-air projects require controlled compression and decompression procedures, emergency arrangements and exposure records.
Decompression sickness can present as joint pain or as a serious central-nervous-system condition.
Compressed-air work can also cause barotrauma and long-term dysbaric osteonecrosis.
Compressed-air risk depends on pressure, plant condition, contamination, task, containment, decompression profile, medical fitness and emergency readiness.
HSE compressed-air evidence is plant-, pressure-, worker-, procedure-, environment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
